```{r library import, echo = FALSE}
library(emmeans)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(readxl)

library(lmerTest)
library(multcomp)
```


## Data Import
```{r data import}
raw_data <- read.csv("../../data/raw/tree_growth/prop_adair_tree_growth_data.csv", na = "NA") %>% 
        dplyr::select(-comment)
raw_data <- raw_data[complete.cases(raw_data),]
raw_data$rs <- as.factor(raw_data$rs)
raw_data$prop_type <- as.factor(raw_data$prop_type)
raw_data$block <- as.factor(raw_data$block)

raw_data <- raw_data %>% 
        rowwise() %>% 
        mutate(can_vol_m3 = can_1_cm/100 * can_2_cm/100 * height_cm/100 / 4,
               di = mean(c(di_1, di_2)),
               thick = mean(c(thick_1, thick_2)), 
               color = mean(c(color_1, color_2)),
               soil_density_kpa = mean(c(sd_1_kpa, sd_2_kpa, sd_3_kpa, sd_4_kpa))) %>% 
        rename(soil_moisture_vwc = soil_vmc_pct)

attach(raw_data)
```

## setting the pvalue table
```{r mixed models, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mm_height <- lmer(height_cm ~ rs*prop_type + (1|block))
mm_rscm <- lmer(rs_cm ~ rs*prop_type + (1|block))
mm_sccm <- lmer(sc_cm ~ rs*prop_type + (1|block))
mm_canvol <- lmer(can_vol_m3 ~ rs*prop_type + (1|block))
mm_di <- lmer(di ~ rs*prop_type + (1|block))
mm_thick <- lmer(thick ~ rs*prop_type + (1|block))
mm_color <- lmer(color ~ rs*prop_type + (1|block))
mm_soildensity <- lmer(soil_density_kpa ~ rs*prop_type + (1|block))

pvalue_table <- function(model_vec, num_factors){
        results <- matrix(NA, nrow = num_factors, ncol = length(model_vec))
        for(i in 1:length(model_vec)){
                aov1 = anova(model_vec[[i]])
                p_values <- aov1$`Pr(>F)`
                results[,i] <- p_values
        }
        # print(results)
        results <- as.data.frame(cbind(rownames(aov1), results))
        #results <- results %>%
         #       mutate(across(V2:V8), as.numeric)
        results
}


 
x <- pvalue_table(c(mm_height, mm_rscm, mm_sccm, mm_canvol, mm_di, mm_thick, mm_color, mm_soildensity), 3)
```

## means extraction for rootstocks
```{r rootstock extraction, echo=TRUE}
means_extract <- function(model_name, spec_factor){
        emm <- emmeans(model_name, spec_factor)
        print(emm)
        emm <- as.data.frame(emm) %>% 
                rowwise() %>% 
                mutate(CI = upper.CL - emmean) %>% 
                dplyr::select(1, emmean, CI)
        emm
}

rs_height <- means_extract(mm_height, spec_factor = "rs")
rs_rscm <- means_extract(mm_rscm, spec_factor = "rs")
rs_sccm <- means_extract(mm_sccm, spec_factor = "rs")
rs_canvol <- means_extract(mm_canvol, spec_factor = "rs")
rs_di <- means_extract(mm_di, spec_factor = "rs")
rs_thick <- means_extract(mm_thick, spec_factor = "rs")
rs_color <- means_extract(mm_color, spec_factor = "rs")
rs_soildensity <- means_extract(mm_soildensity, spec_factor = "rs")


```


## means extraction for each prop method
```{r propagation method extraction, echo=TRUE}
method_height <- means_extract(mm_height, spec_factor = "prop_type")
method_rscm <- means_extract(mm_rscm, spec_factor = "prop_type")
method_sccm <- means_extract(mm_sccm, spec_factor = "prop_type")
method_canvol <- means_extract(mm_canvol, spec_factor = "prop_type")
method_di <- means_extract(mm_di, spec_factor = "prop_type")
method_thick <- means_extract(mm_thick, spec_factor = "prop_type")
method_color <- means_extract(mm_color, spec_factor = "prop_type")
method_soildensity <- means_extract(mm_soildensity, spec_factor = "prop_type")
```


## mean extraction for each interaction
```{r interaction extraction, echo=TRUE}
int_height <- means_extract(mm_height, ~ rs:prop_type)
int_rscm <- means_extract(mm_rscm, ~ rs:prop_type)
int_sccm <- means_extract(mm_sccm, ~ rs:prop_type)
int_canvol <- means_extract(mm_canvol, ~ rs:prop_type)
int_di <- means_extract(mm_di, ~ rs:prop_type)
int_thick <- means_extract(mm_thick, ~ rs:prop_type)
int_color <- means_extract(mm_color, ~ rs:prop_type)
int_soildensity <- means_extract(mm_soildensity, ~ rs:prop_type)
```
